prompt:
Locked-off camera. At the bar: left, the blonde woman in the turquoise fleece with a bum bag, one hand resting on the bar top; centre behind the bar, the red-bearded barman in a black jumper pulling a pint at the hand pump; right, the masked quizmaster in the denim shirt and cream cowboy hat, microphone held low in his right gloved hand. She turns to him and says "Can I get the crisps but not the nuts?" at a brisk natural pace, hopeful, then stops and waits. The barman stops mid-pour, hand still on the pump, glass held still, eyes moving to the quizmaster. The quizmaster turns his head a little toward her, the mask still mostly facing the camera, and answers without a mouth: one slow shake of the head and his free gloved hand lifting and making a small flat sideways gesture (timing only: "Comes as a set."). The white ring and the red triangle stay exactly where they are in the first frame. Only her mouth moves for words; the barman's mouth stays closed. Same bar, same light, only these three people, the picture clean. Small, real pub performance; photographic.
Thanks.
